 26 Best Beauty Advent Calendars You’ll Want to Open All at Once 
 Follow Christmas View feed 26 Best Beauty Advent Calendars You’ll Want to Open All at Once 
 Count down to the holidays with gifts from ULTA, Charlotte Tilbury, Glow Recipe, and more!
 By Catharine Malzahn Published: Nov 5, 2026 View Products Save Article Share Article We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our review process. 
 Each year, I look forward to celebrating the holiday season with a good countdown. Typically, that looks like picking out a beauty advent calendar I’ve been eyeing so that I have new makeup, skincare, or haircare products to open each day before Christmas.
 If you’re anything like me, you’re also looking forward to unwrapping small gifts this advent season from brands like Charlotte Tilbury, L'Occitane, Beekman 1802, and more. I've rounded up the top beauty advent calendars this year that range from seven to 25 days filled with beauty editor favorites, top selling items, and products that are well loved by the Good Housekeeping Institute Beauty & Personal Care Lab. 
 They're known to sell out quickly, so grab yours while you can.
 Best Deal Beekman 1802 The Kindness Cafe Advent Calendar $410 $199 NOW 51% OFF JUMP TO REVIEW 1 ULTA 25 Days of Beauty Advent Calendar
 1 ULTA 25 Days of Beauty Advent Calendar
 $220 Amazon Also Consider $150 Ulta Beauty Full of favorites from brands like Tatcha, The Ordinary, Morphe, Carolina Herrera, and more, there's something for everyone in each day of this calendar. Plus, this set includes a GH Beauty Lab favorite: Drybar Detox Dry Shampoo .
 2 Gift Korean skincare Laneige 12 Days of Wonder Korean Skincare & Lip Favorites Advent Calendar
 2 Gift Korean skincare Laneige 12 Days of Wonder Korean Skincare & Lip Favorites Advent Calendar
 $149 Sephora Also Consider $149 laneige.com This K-beauty brand has a fan in celebrities such as Brooke Shields and our Beauty Lab , making its advent calendar a must-have this season. It includes 12 full and mini sized skincare products, including the Water Sleeping Mask, which was named the best cream Korean face mask by our Beauty Lab.
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 3 Touch up your holiday hair Conair Advent Calendar Hair Accessories Kit
 3 Touch up your holiday hair Conair Advent Calendar Hair Accessories Kit
 $50 Amazon Stocked with 24 pieces of hair accessories ranging from bows to claw clips to scrunchies and more, this advent calendar by Conair has everything you need to make your hairstyles more festive throughout the holiday season.
 4 Tatcha 12 Ways To Love Your Skin Advent Calendar
 4 Tatcha 12 Ways To Love Your Skin Advent Calendar
 $199 Ulta Beauty Also Consider $199 Tatcha $199 Sephora Whether you've been itching to try out Tatcha for the first time or you're a long-time supporter of the brand, you'll be happy to unbox 12 skincare minis that tackle concerns like skin dullness, redness, oiliness, and uneven texture . The calendar also includes The Camellia Cleansing Oil, which is a favorite of GH beauty experts.
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 5 Lancôme Advent Calendar Holiday 2026
 5 Lancôme Advent Calendar Holiday 2026
 $230 Lancome This Lancôme beauty advent calendar will give anyone's routine that signature je ne sais quoi. It's loaded with 24 skincare, makeup, and fragrance products, including eight full sizes, and GH Beauty Lab test-winning Absolue The Eye Cream and Beauty Award-winning La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum.
 6 Several classic go-tos Clarins 24 Day Beauty Advent Calendar Gift Set
 6 Several classic go-tos Clarins 24 Day Beauty Advent Calendar Gift Set
 $155 clarinsusa.com It's hard to go wrong with Clarins, let alone a 24-day set of the brand's top products. Unwrap best sellers like the Lip Comfort Oil Hydrating and Plumping Lip Oil and Total Eye Lift , and you'll be on your way to hydrated, nourished skin.
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 7 All of your drugstore favorites e.l.f. Cosmetics Express Your e.l.f. 24-Day Advent Calendar
 7 All of your drugstore favorites e.l.f. Cosmetics Express Your e.l.f. 24-Day Advent Calendar
 $95 ELF Cosmetics Your favorite drugstore brand is celebrating the holidays in a big way. This advent calendar features 24 makeup and skincare products (17 are full size) , including two products that are exclusive to the calendar: Glow Reviver Melting Lip Balm in Apple Crisp and Smoky Kohl Eyeliner in Pretty Penny.
 8 You can never have enough fragrance GLASSHOUSE FRAGRANCES 12 Days Of Luxury Fragrance Discovery
 8 You can never have enough fragrance GLASSHOUSE FRAGRANCES 12 Days Of Luxury Fragrance Discovery
 $150 glasshousefragrances.com Discover your signature perfume or mix and layer scents to create your own unique fragrance with this 12 day countdown featuring eau de parfum, body wash, body lotion, and hand cream from Glasshouse Fragrances. You'll find a combination of floral, spicy, and bright scents to add to your fragrance wardrobe.
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 9 Indulge in self-care JoyBright by Ulta Beauty 12 Days of Self-Care
 9 Indulge in self-care JoyBright by Ulta Beauty 12 Days of Self-Care
 $22 Ulta Beauty Treat yourself this holiday season with this 12-day calendar from JoyBright by Ulta Beauty. With self-care goodies like bath bombs, body butter, under eye masks, and a loofah , you'll have everything you need for the ultimate girls' night in.
 10 Upgrade their skincare routine Neutrogena 7 Days of Skincare Gift Set
 10 Upgrade their skincare routine Neutrogena 7 Days of Skincare Gift Set
 $40 Amazon Also Consider $40 Walmart They can tackle all of their skin concerns with this seven piece set. It includes acne patches, makeup removing wipes, hand cream, Hydro Boost Gel Cleanser (which is recommended by GH Beauty Lab Director Sabina Wizemann for glowing skin after 50 ), water gel, and a hydrogel mask.
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 11 Unwrap glam MAC 24 Days Of MAC Icons Advent Calendar
 11 Unwrap glam MAC 24 Days Of MAC Icons Advent Calendar
 $250 MAC Cosmetics For 24 days worth of long-lasting (read: will keep up with holiday parties, dinners, and more!) makeup , look no further than MAC's advent calendar. It features classic customer favorites like lipsticks, lip liners, mascaras, and eyeshadows in full and mini sizes.
 12 Share makeup must-haves Benefit Cosmetics The Hotel Beneville 24-Day Beauty Advent Calendar
 12 Share makeup must-haves Benefit Cosmetics The Hotel Beneville 24-Day Beauty Advent Calendar
 $168 Ulta Beauty Also Consider $168 Macy's Fans of Benefit Cosmetics will love this 24-day calendar filled with the brand's top sellers, including mascaras, blush, primer, and more. I personally love the brand's 24-HR Brow Setter shaping gel to keep my brows locked in place, and it's included here, too. A free mirror is also included with purchase .
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 13 Celebrate with a celeb favorite Dr. Hauschka Signature Advent Calendar
 13 Celebrate with a celeb favorite Dr. Hauschka Signature Advent Calendar
 $150 drhauschka.com A brand beloved by celebs and our editors alike, Dr. Hauschka is offering an advent calendar packed with 25 skincare and makeup products. Jennifer Aniston is partial to the brand's Lip Care Stick.
 14 Play with a puzzle Korres Advent Calendar 2026
 14 Play with a puzzle Korres Advent Calendar 2026
 $134 korres.com Twenty-four boxes fit together to create a festive puzzle that you'll want to display all season long . Inside you'll find a combination of skincare and body care, including Korres White Pine Meno-Reverse Volumizing Serum-In-Moisturizer, which was named one the best moisturizers for oily skin .
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 15 A world of sparkling makeup and skincare Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte's Hollywood Beauty Wonderland Advent Calendar
 15 A world of sparkling makeup and skincare Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte's Hollywood Beauty Wonderland Advent Calendar
 $220 Charlotte Tilbury The beautiful red exterior is just the beginning with this box. It hints at all the magic packed inside: 15 of Charlotte Tilbury's biggest beauty best-sellers, including four full-size products, minis, and two accessories . Included are fan favorites like the Beauty Light Wand, Lip Cheat, and Charlotte's Magic Cream. Plus, you can keep the box and use it as storage after the holidays.
 16 Fun, fruity skincare Glow Recipe 12 Days of Glow Advent Calendar Korean Skincare Gift Set
 16 Fun, fruity skincare Glow Recipe 12 Days of Glow Advent Calendar Korean Skincare Gift Set
 $110 Sephora Gift the teen in your life this advent calendar and you'll make their day. From Gen Z-loved brand Glow Recipe comes this 12-day gift set full size, travel size, and mini skincare items, including the brand's well-loved Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops .
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 17 If bubble baths are your love language Lush 12 Days of Christmas
 17 If bubble baths are your love language Lush 12 Days of Christmas
 $130 LUSH Get 12 days worth of relaxation with this advent calendar. After a long day of baking, decorating, and wrapping, pop one of these festive, fizzling bath bombs into the tub for a calming soak . Finish off with a shower gel, scrub, or soap.
 18 Skincare and makeup in one chic package Typology Advent Calendar
 18 Skincare and makeup in one chic package Typology Advent Calendar
 $285 typology.com Secure this highly anticipated Typology Advent Calendar with 24 days of skincare-infused makeup gifts. It includes 14 full-size products and the brand's Lip Oil (a GH Beauty Lab favorite). Who wouldn't feel wonderful receiving it?
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 19 Give the gift of goat milk skincare Beekman 1802 The Kindness Cafe Advent Calendar
 19 Give the gift of goat milk skincare Beekman 1802 The Kindness Cafe Advent Calendar
 Now 51% Off $410 $199 beekman1802.com The adorable Kindness Cafe theme and collectable Barista Goatie are just a few reasons to snap up the Beekman 1802 advent calendar. Another reason is that it is filled with goat milk-based skincare and body care , including editor loved whipped body cream . Plus, the brand has snagged a GH Beauty Award in recent years. What's not to love?
 20 Filled with your favorites L'Occitane Prestige Advent Calendar
 20 Filled with your favorites L'Occitane Prestige Advent Calendar
 $215 L'occitane L'Occitane's advent calendar is here. You'll find the brand's best-selling hand creams, shampoos, gentle soaps, and shower oils , all revealed behind beautifully illustrated artwork. This set of 24 presents features products like GH Beauty Award winner Shea Butter Hand Cream and GH Beauty Lab favorite Almond Shower Oil.
 Catharine Malzahn Contributing beauty writer Catharine Malzahn is a contributing beauty writer at Cosmopolitan and was previously the beauty assistant at Good Housekeeping , Woman's Day , and Prevention .
